tools.name: calculate_mortgage_payment
tools.description: Estimate PITI for a Hawaii purchase: principal and interest, property tax, insurance, HOA, and PMI, FHA MIP, or a financed VA funding fee. Read-only. Do not send a name, email, phone, SSN, or street address. Rates are examples, not quotes.

tools.name: calculate_affordability
tools.description: Estimate a maximum purchase price from gross monthly income, monthly debts, and a DTI target (default 45 for VA and FHA, 41 for conventional and jumbo). Returns the payment at that price. Read-only. No personal identifiers.

tools.name: va_purchase_power
tools.description: Estimate Honolulu County military income (base pay, BAH, BAS, COLA) and a VA purchase price from pay grade, years of service, and dependents. Uses the RealityCents 2026 pay tables. Read-only. Do not send a name or SSN.

tools.name: va_remaining_entitlement
tools.description: For a Hawaii county, compute remaining VA entitlement, the max $0-down loan, and the 25% down payment on any amount above that. $0 already in use is treated as full entitlement (no county cap). Read-only.

tools.name: compare_loans
tools.description: Compare 2 to 4 loan scenarios (type, rate, down payment, term, discount points) on one purchase price. Returns payment, an illustrative cash-to-close, and total interest. Read-only. Rates are examples.

tools.name: calculate_buydown
tools.description: Year-by-year principal-and-interest and subsidy cost for a 2-1, 1-0, or 3-2-1 temporary buydown, or the upfront cost of permanent discount points. Read-only. The note rate is an example, not a quote.

tools.name: rent_vs_buy
tools.description: Compare cumulative rent with the net cost of buying over a holding period, using Honolulu's 0.35% tax default unless you override it. Read-only. Not a price or rent forecast.

tools.name: hawaii_mortgage_guidance
tools.description: Concise factual notes on Hawaii property tax, VA loans, leasehold versus fee simple, VA condo approval, 2026 loan limits, BAH/COLA, closing costs, or pre-approval steps. Drawn from RealityCents articles. No rate quotes. Read-only.

tools.name: lookup_va_condo
tools.description: Check whether an Oahu condo project is on the VA's accepted condo list, by project name (fuzzy), building address, or VA condo ID. tools.name: get_preapproval_link
tools.description: Return Jay Miller's public CMG Home Loans application link and published business contact. Does not ask for or store personal information.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: calculate_mortgage_payment · Private data: get_preapproval_link · Public sink: calculate_mortgage_payment, va_purchase_power, lookup_va_condo.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: calculate_mortgage_payment · Private data: get_preapproval_link · Public sink: calculate_mortgage_payment, va_purchase_power, lookup_va_condo

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
